verdict.rationale: Self-hosted deployments let customers 'turn off logging and make chats 100% private' (greptile-supp-1), but the standard/SaaS offering explicitly reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize customer data for 'AI Training and Learnings' (greptile-supp-2) with no documented opt-out mechanism for that telemetry. Missing for 10: an explicit SaaS-tier telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out toggle, and independent confirmation that opting out actually stops data collection.
